headline: 'People are still afraid of those three letters': Fighting the stigma of HIV
context: That's a quote from former rugby star Gareth Thomas, who is HIV positive. At the International AIDS Conference in Rio this year, he spoke out about the isolation and discrimination tied to the virus.
